Unpack a rewarding sales career with Macfarlane Packaging
At Macfarlane Packaging, we re in the business of protecting what matters - our people, our customers, and the planet. We re equally passionate about growing careers, and this is your opportunity to shine in a role that keeps our sales operations humming. With over 75 years of industry expertise, we combine stability with innovation in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. If you re eager to support a top-performing team and develop your skills in sales administration, read on

Your Role: Internal Sales Coordinator
As our Sales Coordinator, you ll play a pivotal role in underpinning our sales success. You ll be the first point of contact for customer accounts, ensuring smooth order progression and exceptional service. Working closely with our Sales Executives, you ll manage enquiries, process orders, and proactively revive lapsed accounts. Your attention to detail and excellent communication skills will help maintain our high standards and drive operational efficiency.

What You ll Be Doing
- Supporting sales growth by managing and streamlining order progression and customer communications.
- Using our CRM system (MS Dynamics) to track leads, update customer records, and monitor sales activity.
- Proactively contacting lapsed or underutilised accounts to unlock opportunities for up-selling and cross-selling.
- Collaborating with Sales Executives, purchasing, and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfilment.
- Handling customer enquiries and processing orders with precision to maintain service excellence.

What We re Looking For
You ll be an organized and proactive professional with a knack for sales support. We re looking for someone who can keep the wheels turning and add value to our team by ensuring every customer interaction is top-notch. Specifically, we d love to see:
- Minimum of 12 months experience in a sales coordination, administration, or support role.
- Proven track record in handling customer enquiries and outbound calls in a phone-based environment.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with a friendly, professional manner.
- Strong organisational abilities with a keen eye for detail and the capacity to multitask in a fast-paced setting.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with CRM systems (experience with Microsoft Dynamics is advantageous).
- Familiarity with the packaging or distribution sector is a plus.

What You Will Get
We provide a competitive basic salary alongside a rewarding incentive scheme designed to recognise and incentivise success. Our flexible benefits package includes:
- 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 with service) plus all public/bank holidays
- Additional holiday purchase scheme
- Contributory pension scheme
- Employee assistance programme to support wellbeing
- Extensive training and development opportunities
- Employee discount scheme (retail and leisure)
- Annual paid volunteering day
- Simply Health/Dental plan options
- Enhanced HR policies and long service awards
- Charitable giving options
- Financial support with eye tests and glasses (DSE users)
- EE mobile discount scheme

Shape Your Future with Us
At Macfarlane Group, your potential is limitless. We empower our people with structured career pathways and continuous training, so whether you re expanding your skills in sales support or aspiring to new challenges, your future is bright with us.

Ready to Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level

We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds irrespective of your age, gender, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, gender identity, religion, or sexual orientation. title: Sales Executive
description:
Bluestar Business Finance is an established and growing UK finance provider, helping businesses of all sizes access tailored funding solutions to support their ambitions and growth.

We're entering an exciting new chapter, investing in our people, technology and proposition as we build a modern, forward-thinking finance brokerage. With a renewed focus on relationships, delivering exceptional service and understanding our clients' needs, we're creating a business that puts people before transactions and long-term partnerships at the heart of everything we do.

Are you a driven sales professional with a passion for building relationships and helping businesses find the right solutions?

Join us as a Sales Executive and play a key role in developing existing customer relationships, re engaging with previous clients and identifying opportunities to support their evolving business needs. You'll also have the opportunity to build new relationships and introduce funding solutions that help businesses grow.

Working alongside an experienced team, you'll develop your commercial finance knowledge, build a successful career and contribute to the continued growth of the business.

The Role

This is a proactive, business development focused role where you'll be responsible for identifying and engaging with businesses that could benefit from finance solutions.

Using a combination of database management, outbound calls, lead generation and relationship building, you'll reconnect with previous customers, nurture existing relationships and identify opportunities to support their changing funding needs. You'll also engage with prospective clients, introducing Bluestar's services and creating opportunities for the wider team.

Success in this role comes from making effective use of the customer database, building genuine relationships and understanding each client's business rather than simply making sales calls.

You'll primarily work with SME decision makers, helping them explore funding options that support their growth, investment and operational goals.

What You'll Get
- A salary up to 30,000 per annum with uncapped commission
- The opportunity to build a rewarding career within commercial finance
- Exposure to a wide range of funding solutions and lenders
- Full support from an experienced and knowledgeable team
- Ongoing training, development and mentoring
- The chance to be part of a growing business where your contribution makes a real impact
- A collaborative culture where ideas are valued and success is recognised

About You

You'll likely have experience in:
- Sales, customer service or business development roles
- Building relationships over the phone and developing rapport with customers
- Working towards targets and delivering consistent results
- Prospecting, lead generation or outbound calling activity
- Commercial finance, asset finance, leasing or related industries (desirable)

Experience within commercial finance, asset finance, leasing or a finance brokerage environment would be advantageous. However, we're equally interested in individuals with strong communication skills, commercial awareness and a genuine desire to develop a career in the industry.

It's an exciting time to join us and play a part in shaping the future of the business.

Do you enjoy talking to customers and helping them find the right product? We are looking for a friendly, organised Sales Executive / Sales Representative to sell new and used forklifts, material handling equipment and plant machinery to customers across the UK and overseas.

You will speak to customers by phone, email and face to face, prepare quotations and follow up sales leads. You do not need forklift experience. We provide full product and forklift training, and you will learn from an experienced team.

ABOUT PHL UK LTD

PHL is one of Europe's largest forklift truck wholesalers. We prepare and sell forklifts and material handling equipment to customers worldwide from a busy and growing site in Basingstoke, Hampshire with nearly 1,000 machines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Speak with customers regularly by phone, email and face to face.
- Sell new and used forklifts and material handling equipment in the UK and overseas.
- Respond to customer enquiries and follow up sales leads.
- Prepare quotations and follow them up with customers.
- Build good relationships with existing customers and find new ones.
- Keep accurate customer and sales records on our CRM and other systems.
- Learn about our stock and the different types of equipment.
- Work closely with our marketing, transport and workshop teams.
- Work towards sales targets and build your own customer base.

Experience from any of these areas would be a good fit: sales, internal or inside sales, account management, business development, telesales, customer service, trade counter, plant hire, machinery or engineering. Experience of selling to businesses (B2 B) is a bonus, but it is not essential.

The most important thing is finding the right person, so we will train you in everything about our products.

Essential:
- Good spoken and written English, because you will deal with customers by phone and email every day.
- Confidence speaking to customers on the phone.
- Comfortable using computers, including email, Word and Excel, and happy to learn new software such as a CRM system.
- Well organised, with good attention to detail when preparing quotations.
- Able to work independently and as part of a team.
- Keen to learn about our products and the industry.
- The right to work in the UK.

Useful, but not essential:
- Previous sales experience in any field.
- Experience in machinery, plant, engineering or industrial equipment.
- Experience using a CRM system, such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

- Salary: £25,600 to £34,500 per year, depending on experience
- Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire
- Holiday: 20 days plus 8 bank holidays (28 days in total)
- Workplace pension scheme
- Company sick pay scheme
- Full product and forklift training provided
- The chance to progress and develop your own customer base

Apply online through this job listing. In your application, please tell us:
- Do you have the right to work in the UK?

- Do you have experience of dealing with customers by phone and email?
